title: NSRA: Neuro-Symbolic Register Allocator
shortDescription: Engineered a Gradient Boosting model (92.3% F1-score) to optimize compiler register allocation, reducing memory operations by 2.9%.
detailedDescription: NSRA bridges the gap between machine learning and traditional compiler backends. By introducing a hybrid neuro-symbolic approach, it accurately predicts spilled registers during instruction scheduling while retaining strict formal correctness guarantees.
highlights: Trained Gradient Boosting model achieving 92.3% F1-score on compiler benchmark suites.
Integrated automated formal verification layer ensuring 100% execution correctness.
Built a PySide6 dashboard for visual inspection of compiler register allocation.

title: TRIAGE-OOM: Predictive OOM Crash Prevention
shortDescription: Real-time predictive monitoring service using eBPF memory telemetry to detect container crash risks before occurrence.
detailedDescription: TRIAGE-OOM leverages low-overhead eBPF kernel probes to trace cgroup v2 memory allocations, page faults, and swap usage. When high OOM risk is detected, a proactive cgroup-freezer intervention is executed to preserve container state without kernel kills.
highlights: Achieved 0% false-positive rate across 4 production workload types (Postgres, Redis, Compute, Flask).
Low-overhead eBPF telemetry capturing page cache dynamics with <0.5% CPU overhead.
Automated cgroup-freezer intervention pausing at-risk containers before Linux OOM killer triggers.

title: DIALECT: AI Debate & Public Speaking Platform
shortDescription: Real-time debate platform supporting text, voice, and video sessions for 50+ concurrent users with AI feedback.
detailedDescription: DIALECT is a full-stack platform designed to help users improve public speaking skills through competitive debates. Includes Elo-based matchmaking, real-time WebRTC media streaming, and an anonymous Ghost Mode for anxiety-free speaking practice.
highlights: Supports 50+ concurrent user debate rooms with real-time audio/video streaming via WebRTC.
Features Elo-based matchmaking algorithm for balanced competitive debate pairings.
Integrated AI feedback engine conducting sentiment analysis, filler word detection, and vocabulary scoring.
